residue.label: Registry Context runtime owner unresolved
residue.description: The Product owner can author candidate business meaning and contracts, but no owner has accepted responsibility for the future resolver runtime and its adapters.
residue.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner must nominate a Registry Context runtime owner
residue.next_action: Run one explicit owner/root/cap/isolation decision before runtime implementation.

residue.label: Generic Registry has no canonical Definition
residue.description: Registry is modeled only as a package-local candidate concept. Existing packages expose registries, but CyberAlchemy v2 has not promoted a generic Registry definition.
residue.next_action: Use the local concept for the experiment; evaluate canonical promotion only after repeated cross-module use reveals a stable invariant.

residue.label: Resolution run ledger deferred
residue.description: The first read-only proof does not need a persistent ledger. If later added, it must contain append-only run records only and must not become registry or context truth.
residue.next_action: Re-evaluate after a deterministic CLI proof produces repeated runs that need audit or replay.

residue.label: CLI and chat adapters deferred
residue.description: Interactive question presentation and shared CLI/chat session behavior depend on the read-only Registry Context request and view contract, but are outside this first package.
residue.owner_route: future Registry Context runtime owner plus Define and Language interface owners
residue.next_action: Design adapters only after the same request resolves deterministically twice through the first runtime slice.
